notes: The two καί of the apodosis are taken as and (s025) and also (s021), the latter discontinuously; reading the first καί as unrepresented and giving and also whole to the second remains defensible.
The second attributive τό before ἀπὸ τοῦ καινοῦ is unrepresented because the ASV supplies no relative clause there, under rules 23 and 31.
